Title: Netherlands – Distribution transformers – Compact stations
Procedure title: Compact stations
Description: In order for Gasunie to achieve the intended result of the contract (see section 2.1.1), you shall be required to perform various activities, also referred to as the ‘contract scope’. These activities are, in general terms, outlined below: • Engineering, manufacturing, assembly, testing (FAT), transportation to Gasunie site and testing on site (SAT) of compact stations. • Each compact station contains: o Concrete housing. o One hermetically sealed oil type 400 kVA 33kV/0,41 kV transformer. o One low voltage distribution board. o One socket outlet rack on the outside of the compact station. • Engineering, manufacturing, assembly, testing (FAT), transportation and testing on site (SAT) of one walkable enclosure: o Steel housing/container (to contain a dry type 6.3MVA 33kV/20kV transformer the transformer will be supplied by Gasunie). o 20 kV switchgear including 1 incoming and 2 outgoing feeders. • FAT at supplier’s factory. • SAT including testing on site and commissioning support.
